props.name: context
props.meaning: The widget context. The options and the status table are read through it, once per page.

props.name: entity_type
props.meaning: The type whose status field is offered.

props.name: project_id
props.meaning: Offer the codes this project allows.

props.name: project_ids
props.meaning: Offer the codes every one of these projects allows.

props.name: field
props.meaning: A list or status field other than the type's own.

props.name: value
props.meaning: The selected code. `bind:value` in Svelte, `value` with `onValueChange` in React.

props.name: placeholder
props.meaning: Shown with no selection.

props.name: empty_label
props.meaning: Shown when the field offers nothing.

props.name: loading_label
props.meaning: Names the skeletons a read stands behind, for a screen reader.

props.name: error_label
props.meaning: Shown in place of what the failed read said.

props.name: clearable
props.meaning: Offers a control that clears the value. Unset, it follows the field: a mandatory one is never clearable.

props.name: readonly
props.meaning: Keeps full contrast and drops the chevron, the popup and the clear control.

props.name: disabled
props.meaning: Greys the control and takes it out of the tab order.

props.name: invalid
props.meaning: Sets `aria-invalid` and the destructive ring.

props.name: show_code
props.meaning: Draws the code as a row's right-aligned secondary, when it says more than the label.

props.name: secondary
props.meaning: A row's right-aligned value, of the caller's own making.

props.name: sub_label
props.meaning: The muted line under a row's label.

props.name: site_url
props.meaning: Passed to every badge, for a sprite cell outside the status icon set.

props.name: size
props.meaning: Control height: 7, 8 and 9.

props.name: open
props.meaning: Whether the popup is showing. Two-way in Svelte.

events.name: value_changed
events.when: A status was chosen, or the clear control was pressed.

keyboard.does: Selects the highlighted status and closes
In an empty search box, clears the status
Leaves the control, or reaches the clear control when there is one
